title: Cheese Grater Reverse Engineering
overview: This project involves reverse-engineering a plastic kitchen cheese grater. I worked with 8 components through disassembly, part measurement, sketching, 3D modeling, and final product assembly.
objective: This project was completed as part of a class term assignment. The goal was to develop familiarity with disassembly and reconstruction of real-world objects to gain an understanding of their design features, how components interact, and the underlying manufacturing considerations.
skills: Advanced SolidWorks modeling (patterned extrusions, swept profiles, shelling, symmetric and asymmetric lofts)

obstacles_and_solutions.obstacle: Obtaining accurate measurements due to the enclosed design of the product.
obstacles_and_solutions.solution: Averaged multiple measurement samples and cross-referenced them with mated parts in the assembly.

obstacles_and_solutions.obstacle: Establishing core geometry for each part.
obstacles_and_solutions.solution: Applied advanced modeling techniques and consulted the SolidWorks community for software troubleshooting.
